name: Owner CRM public consent browser compatibility
description: Allow non-browser email clients on signed native Mautic opt-out routes only. Preserve all other zone protections.

rules.description: Native signed email consent routes must work for email clients
rules.expression: (http.host eq "mail.blockwise.sale" and http.request.method in {"GET" "POST"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/email/unsubscribe/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/email/dnc/")))
